data.title: Getting started
data.lead: Mechanica is a visual block editor for Vue. Author blocks as real Vue components, arrange them on the page, and export a static site.

sections.heading: Install
sections.body: Clone the repo and run bun install. Start the editor playground with bun run dev, and export a static site with bun run export.

sections.heading: Author a block
sections.body: A block is a Vue SFC whose <script setup> calls the defineBlock macro. Its props become the editable fields shown in the editor's settings panel.

sections.heading: Link between pages
sections.body: Use the smartLink field to point at another page: search by name or path and the link's title is filled in for you. This page links back home below.
